Definitely a step up from the Abnormals.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 5 (Formerly, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen Dreg''' is an enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has quite high amount of health for its debut, and a relatively quicker speed than the [[Abnormal]]. It has [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]] by default, making it spawn a [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]] on death. == Logbook Description == "''Fallen Dregs were laborers who once lived in Paradise. When the Queen's curse took hold, their bodies were engulfed with flames that burn eternally. They wear the traditional armor of their society, which once featured a bright white gem at its center. Even in death, their corpses continue to burn as a reminder of the Queen's sacrifice.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Dreg''' has blue skin. It does not have a head or a torso, exposing its blue skeleton. It also has a skull, It wears a grey and blue chestplate, shoulder-pads, arm-pads, knee-pads, shoes and pants, and it has a grey cape with a gem upfront. It also has blue fire coming out of the top of its skull. ==Strategy== *The '''Fallen Dreg''' has a higher health than both the [[Abnormal]] and [[Quick]], as well as the [[Fallen Skeleton]] itself. It is also faster than the [[Abnormal]], making it a rather dangerous enemy. **Cheap early-game towers with decent DPS, like the [[Cowboy]], [[Brawler]], [[Golden Scout]] or [[Trapper]] can be used. **As they spawn in hordes, splash damage towers like the [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]] can clear them out quite well. *The '''Fallen Dreg''' spawns with the [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]] attribute by default, which allows it to spawn a corpse of itself upon its death. Because of this, it will act as a shield for enemies behind it. **In the earlier waves upon and after its debut, it is best to set some of your towers to ''First'', ''Random'', or ''Strongest'' depending on the wave, that deal less damage such as the [[Scout]] to deal with the '''Fallen Dreg's''' corpse, as a low damage output won't be affected much by the corpses 100% defense. The rest of your towers should focus on defeating the other enemies that spawn alongside. *You can use early defense dropping towers like the [[Electroshocker]] to drop the '''Fallen Dreg's''' defense, though, this is usually not recommended. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FallenDregWalk.gif|Walking animation (11 June 2025 – Present) Fallen_Drug.gif|Stun animation (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenDreg.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Dreg.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Summer Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Dreg''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FallenDregIconIG.png|'''Fallen Dreg''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Fallen Dreg''' existed in the game prior to its proper addition, though it went unused as it was scrapped before the release of the [[v1.27.0]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode rework. **It was later properly introduced in [[v1.67.0]] as a replacement for the [[Heavy]]. ***However, the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] still mentioned the [[Heavy]] until [[v1.68.0]]. *The current appearance is a recolored version of the [[Korblox Undead (The Hunt)|Korblox Undead]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''11 June 2025''' -
